This E log book also reflects my patient-centered online learning portfolio and your valuable inputs cough with sputum\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003ECheif complaint\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient complains of breathlessness since 4days\u0026nbsp; and cough since 3days.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of present illness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient was apparently asymptomatic 4 days back then he developed breathlessness with gradual onset grade 2-3 associated with chest tightness ,wheeze , seasonal variation, aggrevated on cool air and dust.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECough with sputum since 3 days ,\u0026nbsp; mucopurulent, non blood stained, not foul smelling, no seasonal variation, more during night time, aggrevated on cold exposure.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of allergy with cough, watery eyes on exposure to dust.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo history of fever, palpitations, haemoptysis, chest pain, weight loss, loss of appetite, burning micturation.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cb\u003EHistory of past illness\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/b\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPatient complains of similar history in past.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAdmission to\u0026nbsp; Hospital twice in 2018 and 2021 and diagnosed as acute exacerbation of asthma with bronchiectasis.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPneumococcal vaccine taken on 19-10-21\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EInfluenza vaccine on 20-10-21\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EUsage of inhaler formonide,\u0026nbsp; with metred dose inhaler with spacer from 2 years and stopped since 1 month.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EHistory of diabetes mellitus on medication\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENo History of TB, cad, epilepsy ,
